name: art-player
description: <canvas is="art-player_1">: the universal canvas inside an ArtPlayer, whose controls drive the Bevara pipeline
help: Customised built-in canvas (is="art-player_1"): plays the source named by src="…" through the solver named by using="…" and the accessors named by with="…", with the ArtPlayer interface (play, pause, volume, fullscreen; progress and seeking once the solver knows the duration). ArtPlayer options go in options='{…}' as JSON. art-player_1.js carries everything, ArtPlayer included.

patents.note: custom HTML element and player interface
